---
title: "Electricity Consumption Time Series Analysis - Malaysia"
author: "TEAM"
date: "18-06-2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(forecast)
library(feasts)  

df <- read_csv("electricity_consumption.csv")

df_total <- df %>%
  filter(sector == "total") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  select(date, consumption) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date)

autoplot(df_total, consumption) +
  ggtitle("Time Series Plot of Electricity Consumption") +
  ylab("Consumption (MWh)") +
  xlab("Date")

ggseasonplot(ts_data, year.labels = TRUE, year.labels.left = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Seasonal Plot: Electricity Consumption by Month") +
  ylab("Consumption (MWh)") +
  xlab("Month")

df_total %>%
  gg_subseries(consumption) +
  ggtitle("Electricity Consumption by Month (gg_subseries)") +
  ylab("Consumption (MWh)") +
  xlab("Year within Month")
```
